CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient Name: [redacted name]
Date of Birth: [redacted date]
Medical Record Number: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Amniotic fluid
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INFORMATION
Reason for Referral: Advanced maternal age (40 years)
Gestational Age at Sampling: 28 weeks
Clinical Indication: Screening for trisomy 21 and other chromosomal abnormalities

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded Chromosome Analysis (Karyotype)

METHODOLOGY
Amniotic fluid cells were cultured using standard cytogenetic techniques. Metaphase chromosomes were harvested and G-banded using trypsin-Giemsa staining. A minimum of 20 metaphase cells were analyzed at a resolution of 450-550 bands. Karyotype designation follows the International System for Human Cytogenomic Nomenclature (ISCN 2020).

RESULTS
Karyotype: 46,XY

Number of cells analyzed: 20
Number of cells counted: 5
Band resolution: 500 bands

INTERPRETATION
Normal male karyotype (46,XY). No evidence of trisomy 21 or other chromosomal abnormalities detected. All analyzed metaphases showed a normal male chromosome complement with no numerical or structural abnormalities identified at the resolution of this analysis.

This result indicates a chromosomally normal male fetus. The absence of trisomy 21 (Down syndrome), trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome), trisomy 13 (Patau syndrome), and sex chromosome abnormalities provides reassurance regarding these specific conditions.

LIMITATIONS
This test cannot detect chromosomal mosaicism below the level of approximately 10-15%. Subtle structural rearrangements below the resolution of conventional cytogenetics may not be detected. This analysis does not rule out single gene disorders, microdeletion/microduplication syndromes below 5-10 Mb, or other genetic conditions not detectable by karyotype analysis.

NOTE
This report supersedes the preliminary rapid aneuploidy detection (QF-PCR) report issued on [redacted date].

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorized by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist

For clinical queries, please contact the laboratory at [redacted phone number]
